parsed.name: 苏黎世仪器UHF系列设备
parsed.description: 用于连接和控制苏黎世仪器 UHF 系列仪器，支持设备连接、AWG 配置、示波采集、触发参数设置、DIO 校准、时钟与采样相关设置，以及通过数据服务器进行节点读写与数据订阅。常用于量子测控和高速电子信号实验。
parsed.description_en: Used to connect to and control Zurich Instruments UHF series instruments. It supports device connection, AWG configuration, scope acquisition, trigger setup, DIO calibration, clock and sampling settings, and node read/write plus data subscription through the data server. It is commonly used in quantum control and high-speed electronic signal experiments.
